description: This file defines a custom exception class `SmartyException` for the Smarty templating engine, extending the base `Exception` class and providing a custom string representation.

classes.name: SmartyException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Smarty, extending PHP's built-in Exception class, with a custom __toString method and a static $escape property.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representation of the exception message, escaping it if the static property `$escape` is true.
